title: Distinguishing reach from repeat use
method: Synthetic cohort: 40/1,000 = 4% workforce usage, 40/200 = 20% eligible adoption, and 24/40 = 60% repeat use among initial users. Counts refer to two comparable reporting cycles and are not external benchmarks.
alt: Distinguishing reach from repeat use. All employees: 1000 people, Eligible reporters: 200 people, Tried assistant: 40 people, Returned next cycle: 24 people. Illustrative data.
